entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (knee/ankle) remained sidelined at practice Friday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Bam Knight
entries.summary: Knight (concussion) is out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Prior to meeting with 49ers officials Friday, Aiyuk (personal) told assembled media that he's "feeling great, healthy" and "looking to get reinstated to the National Football League," Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (knee) will miss Sunday's game against Las Vegas and may need surgery for a meniscus injury, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday that Montgomery (groin) has made some progress but is still viewed as week-to-week and will remain out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) didn't participate in the early portion of Friday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Wicks (ankle) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Dyami Brown
entries.summary: Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to a calf injury.

entries.name: Elijah Sarratt
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Garrett Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson (concussion) is out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Josh Whyle
entries.summary: Whyle (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Kedon Slovis
entries.summary: Slovis (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against Jacksonville but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Nick Wagoner of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Rashid Shaheed
entries.summary: Shaheed (knee) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of 933 KJR reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Darnold (quadriceps), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, is considered week-to-week, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (illness) won't play Sunday against the Packers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Treylon Burks
entries.summary: Burks (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is officially listed as doubtful for Sunday's game versus the Texans.

entries.name: Cam Skattebo
entries.summary: Skattebo (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
entries.summary: St. Brown (ribs) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Tim Twentyman of the Lions' official site reports.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (ribs) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

entries.name: Demond Claiborne
entries.summary: Claiborne (knee) did not participate in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Deshaun Watson
entries.summary: Watson (concussion) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, but Shedeur Sanders will start even if Watson is active Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) was a limited practice participant Friday.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game in Chicago.

entries.name: George Pickens
entries.summary: Pickens (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Indianapolis, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Hunter Henry
entries.summary: Henry (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Jacob Saylors
entries.summary: Saylors (neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: Jennings (calf) did not participate in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (quad) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (back) is questionable for Sunday's matchup against Washington, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Joshua Palmer
entries.summary: Palmer (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Kaytron Allen
entries.summary: Allen (quadriceps) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Lions, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (shoulder) was a limited practice participant Friday.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (hamstring) is recovering from a Grade 2 strain "that will keep him out for Monday's game and potentially beyond," Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Luke Schoonmaker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: MarShawn Lloyd
entries.summary: Lloyd (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

entries.name: Nikko Remigio
entries.summary: Remigio (hip) has been deemed questionable to suit up against the Jets on Sunday.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

entries.name: Tanner McKee
entries.summary: McKee (ribs) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Giants.

entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Thursday's game versus the Jaguars, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals in Madrid, Spain,, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (fibula) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Texans.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dean Connors
entries.summary: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: Robinson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, with 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan saying Friday that the wideout likely will be activated from injured reserve, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Erick All Jr.
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: McMillan (knee) isn't expected back until after Tampa Bay's Week 10 bye, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen working off to the side during the Panthers' unofficial practice Tuesday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Tyson (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kendrick Bourne
entries.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: The Ravens have officially placed Jackson (thumb) on injured reserve.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Hollins (calf) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Coach Sean Payton said Friday that Bryant (ankle) is in line to play in Sunday's game against the Panthers, Chris Tomasson of the Denver Gazette reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: Rivers (calf) does not have a designation for Sunday's clash against the Commanders, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) was expected to return for Sunday's game against Washington, but he's been ruled out after injuring his hamstring during Friday's practice, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Tyler Huntley
entries.summary: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
